import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = list(range(1, 11))
y = [value ** 2 for value in x]

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))
plt.plot(x, y, marker='o')
plt.xlabel('x')
plt.ylabel('y = x²')
plt.title('y = x² for x from 1 to 10')
plt.xlim(1, 10)
plt.ylim(0, 100)
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout()
